# Summit Marketing

> We train and field door-to-door sales reps. You knock, you close, you get paid on what you close.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Summit Marketing and the earnings calculator.
- [Recruiting](/recruiting): What the role looks like, and how to apply.
- [Rookie Application](/apply/rookie): Apply as a first-time sales rep.
- [Veteran Application](/apply/veteran): Apply as an experienced sales professional.
- [Parents](/parents): A plain explanation of the summer sales job, housing, safety and how pay works.
- [Golden Ticket](/ticket): You were handed a Trinity ticket. Leave your details and a manager will reach out.
- [Pest Control](/industries/pest): Door-to-door pest control. The summer product. You close, you get paid on what you close.
- [Fiber Internet](/industries/fiber): Door-to-door fiber internet. The winter product. Paid per install. Sells year-round.
- [Life Insurance](/industries/life): Life insurance. One of our three industries, alongside pest control and fiber internet. Requires a state license to sell.
